plugins.name: superskillret
plugins.description: Embedding-based skill retrieval. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool (ThakiCloud/SKILLRET) and injects them as context, using the ThakiCloud/SkillRet-Embedding-0.6B encoder behind a long-running local daemon. v0.2.7: install.sh self-cleans its lock; retrieve.py prefers .installed marker (avoids stale-lock false positives) and the wait notice now shows the install log tail. v0.2.6 daemon_client.py. v0.2.5 dedup default OFF. v0.2.0–0.2.4 custom skill registration + UX fixes.
